# CVE allowlist for the dockerhub project -- see docs/harbor-stack/README.md
# Open Investigation section and docs/pentagi-stack/harness-target.md.
#
# Scope: harness-target-struts2 (dockerhub/vulhub/struts2:2.3.30) is a
# DELIBERATELY vulnerable target (CVE-2017-5638, unauth OGNL injection) used
# by the PentAGI test harness -- it runs an ancient Debian 9 base on purpose.
# These are every CVE ID found in its Trivy scan as of 2026-08-15, MINUS
# CVE-2021-31879 (also present in itzg/minecraft-server, a real production
# image sharing the dockerhub project -- confirmed via a full cross-check
# against every other Critical-severity dockerhub image's own CVE list
# before this file was built, specifically to avoid this project-level
# allowlist silently suppressing a real finding elsewhere in the project).
#
# This is a point-in-time snapshot, not a live sync with Trivy's DB --
# expect it to need refreshing if the struts2 target image is ever rebuilt
# or Trivy's DB changes what it detects. One CVE ID per line.
